text.c04: [warmly] Hoh… someone stepping out of the light. From the future, you say? Splendid — this is my Gifu!
text.c06: [politely] I am a guest too. My lord's boasting runs long, I warn you.
text.c10: [proudly] Look at this garden and waterfall. Even the southern missionary stood here open-mouthed.
text.c12: [whispers] Nothing pleases my lord more than showing off to guests.
text.c16: [excited] Very well! It is a steep path — keep up!
text.c18: [proudly] …Behold. The whole Nōbi plain. From here I shall take the realm.
text.c20: [calmly] The wind is strong… A fine view indeed.
text.c24: [softly] Let me make you tea — with my own hands. …It's hot.
text.c27: [surprised] Oh, ice in summer… ice from the ice-house!
text.c32: [excited] Cormorant fishing! Here come the fire boats!
text.c38: [thoughtfully] Who knew fire and water could be so beautiful…
text.c41: [whispers] …When the realm is at peace, I'd like us all out on the boats again, like this.
text.c45: [proudly] A gift for you. Let me stamp my seal: "Tenka Fubu"!
